title: carex michelii var. beckeri

This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Carex michelii var. beckeri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may exhibit therapeutic actions such as protecting against oxidative stress and inflammation.
